items.title: One-location radial level law

source.anchor: §4.1.1 Eq. (13)–(16), footnote 2; §6.2 actual H_k marginal in the application of Fact 10
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, CC BY 4.0. Samplinglib isolates the marginal from the independence and conditioning claims.

items.statement: Fix a level i and any deterministic trailing location x_i,…,x_h. Under the unconditioned standard Gaussian on the full ordered coefficient space, the level field H_i, formed by applying the exact radial cutoff to the angular sum, is centered Gaussian with variance n C_i(x)² v_i. A zero participating block gives the identically zero field and the point mass at zero.
assumptions: n is positive, h is natural and 0≤i≤h. The paper prescribes large n and a particular depth; the isolated scalar law does not use that regime and does not extend admissibility.
The fixed location supplies exactly the participating blocks x_i through x_h in ℝⁿ. No nonzero-block hypothesis is imposed on the whole theorem, and no lower bound on the cutoff is assumed.

Only the unconditioned coefficient vector Ξ is random. Its full ordered Euclidean carrier has a block of dimension n^(p S_i) for each level i and allowed degree p. The level law does not assert independence from any random history.

formulae.label: Exact cutoff from footnote 2 and Eq. (16)
Angular model and variance scale
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}K=2^{74(h+1)},\quad P=2^{64(h+1)},\quad S_i=\sum_{j=0}^{h-i}K^j,\quad \mathcal P=\{4,6,\ldots,P\},\\ a_{i,p}=\frac1{p^4S_i^2\sqrt{(h-i+1)\log(2PS_i)}},\quad v_i=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}a_{i,p}^2,\\ \psi_i(u)=\bigotimes_{j=i}^h u_j^{\otimes K^{j-i}},\qquad F_i^\Xi(u)=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\sqrt n\,a_{i,p}\langle\Xi_{i,p},\psi_i(u)^{\otimes p}\rangle.\end{gathered}

formulae.label: Actual one-point law
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}H_i^\Xi(x)=\begin{cases}0 & \exists j\ge i:\ x_j=0,\\C_i(x)\,F_i^\Xi((x_j/\|x_j\|)_{j=i}^h)&\text{otherwise},\end{cases}\\ H_i^\Xi(x)\sim\mathcal N(0,n C_i(x)^2 v_i),\qquad \mathcal N(0,0)=\delta_0.\end{gathered}

obligations.label: Use the literal shell cutoff and zero extension of the angular field
Prove the exact unconditioned one-location Gaussian law, including degeneracy

bindings.boundary: Exact one-point marginal, including the Dirac case, only. No shell derivative/support estimates, joint process law, multi-level aggregation, independence from earlier coefficients, conditional integration, Eq. (51), or main lower bounds.

assumption_deltas.source: Fixed x in the hard-family dimension and depth regime.
assumption_deltas.lean: Fixed trailing blocks for every positive n and natural h.
assumption_deltas.reason: Earlier spatial blocks do not enter H_i. The marginal computation is finite-dimensional and does not need the admissibility parameter choices.

assumption_deltas.source: Eq. (16), footnote 2, and the zero-extension convention.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exact rational cutoffs, unscaled expNegInvGlue, and an explicit zero branch.
assumption_deltas.reason: No normalized transition is substituted for the source rho quotients. Division by the norm is only used to obtain unit vectors in the nonzero branch.

assumption_deltas.source: Centered Gaussian with variance n C_i(x)² v_i, also stated when applying Fact 10 to the next level.
assumption_deltas.lean: Only the unconditioned law; no independence or regular conditional law is supplied or claimed.
assumption_deltas.reason: This binding isolates the scalar marginal of that sentence; independence and conditioning remain separate source obligations.
